result.brief: 提出以未来物理效果 token 为预测目标的 VLA 策略，属机器人操作控制，与视频/多模态世界模型及视觉表征学习无直接关联。
result.reason: Main contribution is a VLA robot policy predicting future "Effect" tokens for manipulation control; no video/multimodal world model or visual representation contribution, and robot policy is not world modeling.
